clue.text: Mix during school days, linger endlessly about

explanation.surface: Pupils mixing during term time and hanging around aimlessly afterwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mix' sits at the front looking like the start of the surface sentence, but it is the whole definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: things that intermingle are mixed in together, as crowds do.

clue.text: Reconstructed tiny landing in mad style

blocks.note: the eleven letters of TINY LANDING rearranged

explanation.surface: A cramped landing has been rebuilt in some crazy style.

clue.text: Nervous retiring slow information technology

clue.text: Controlled endless royal household bitterness

clue.text: Move carefully in check

clue.text: Complain audibly after spirit in drink

clue.text: Register of names, rough but not right, written up for teacher?

clue.text: Besotted admirer of procrastinator’s credo?
